purpose: Authorship and trust signals for a health (YMYL) website

on_site.author_entity: All pages use the Person @id https://www.alasdairmaclullich.com/#person, the same entity described on alasdairmaclullich.com, with its sameAs list (ORCID, University of Edinburgh profile, Research Explorer, Google Scholar, Scopus, OpenAlex, ISNI, Library of Congress, Wikidata Q48288045, Wikipedia, LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Substack) and worksFor the University of Edinburgh (Wikidata Q160302)
on_site.visible_author_links: Home page authors section and the footer of every page link to alasdairmaclullich.com, the University of Edinburgh profile, ORCID, Google Scholar and Wikipedia; the editorial policy also links the Research Explorer
on_site.credentials_shown: Professor of Geriatric Medicine, University of Edinburgh; consultant physician, Royal Infirmary of Edinburgh; creator of the 4AT; co-chair of SIGN 157 (2019); co-founder of the European Delirium Association; Editor-in-Chief of Delirium
on_site.editorial_responsibility: Named on the home page answers, the quotations page and in structured data (accountablePerson, editor). Not marked as reviewedBy, because the author has not yet read and approved the four answers
on_site.dates: Page reviewed and published dates shown on the home page, Chapter 1 and quotations pages, with matching dateModified and datePublished
on_site.sources: Figures on the home page are sourced on editorial.html#sources
